mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS child_id, c.name AS child_name, c.avatar AS child_avatar, COUNT(i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.id IS NOT NULL) AS total_tasks, COUNT(i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'DONE') AS done_tasks, COUNT(i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'APPROVED') AS approved_tasks, COUNT(i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'PENDING') AS pending_tasks, COALESCE(SUM(i.points) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'APPROVED'), 0) AS earned_points FROM child c LEFT JOIN task_instance i ON i.child_id = c.id AND i.plan_date = #{planDate} WHERE c.active = TRUE GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.avatar ORDER BY c.id

SELECT DATE(d.day) AS day, c.id AS child_id, c.name AS child_name, COALESCE(SUM(pr.change_points) FILTER (WHERE pr.type = 'EARN'), 0) AS earned FROM generate_series(#{startDate}::date, #{endDate}::date, interval '1 day') AS d(day) CROSS JOIN child c LEFT JOIN point_record pr ON pr.child_id = c.id AND DATE(pr.created_at) = DATE(d.day) WHERE c.active = TRUE GROUP BY d.day, c.id, c.name ORDER BY d.day, c.id

SELECT cat.id AS category_id, cat.name AS category_name, cat.icon AS category_icon, cat.color AS category_color, COALESCE(SUM(i.points), 0) AS total_points FROM task_category cat LEFT JOIN task_instance i ON i.category_id = cat.id AND i.plan_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND i.status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY cat.id, cat.name, cat.icon, cat.color ORDER BY cat.sort_order
